caption: The drawing is a top-down view of a garden and house arrangement, with colorful, symmetrical floral borders on the left and right edges featuring a variety of flowers and vegetables in shades of pink, purple, white, orange, green, and yellow. In the central area, there are geometric green lawns and beige walkways forming a layout that divides the space. The largest structure is a red-roofed house centered towards the bottom half, with a chimney and a small porch facing a white picket fence at the bottom edge. Adjacent to the house is a square lawn with bushes along the walkway. Above and to the right of the house, another red-roofed building sits near a brown area containing two chickens. Rectangular plots of various green shades at the top represent cultivated garden beds, aligned neatly in rows. There are scattered trees and round bushes in dark green, with a single tall conifer at the central axis of the image. Towards the right, a patterned area consists of alternating diamond shapes in yellow, green, blue, and purple. The entire scene is framed by the detailed floral borders, adding bright and pastel accents to the overall composition, while the main garden and house areas are dominated by greens, reds, and earth tones.
title: Samuel Harrison House and Garden
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
